study type: Secondary analysis of a global cohort study with a nested case-control design.
cohort: The study participants were 2558 pregnant or recently pregnant women with suspected or confirmed infection from 713 health facilities across 52 low-, middle-, and high-income countries.
finding: Key risk factors for severe maternal outcomes (SMO) include prior childbirths, hemorrhage, trauma, pre-existing conditions, and hospital-acquired or secondary infections.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean section was identified as a risk factor for severe maternal outcomes.
